title: L7 router deployment into your core.
description: We set up and configure our router at the center of your network, wired to your real services and routes, handed over in working order. Measured in days.

title: Incident response.
description: When something breaks, an engineer who already knows your system is in within minutes and acts mid-fire: reroutes around the failing node, isolates the segment, gracefully degrades the non-essential so the critical keeps running.

title: Readiness, maintained.
description: Between incidents we keep an up-to-date map of your infrastructure and a response plan that tracks your changes — so when something fails, the response is measured in minutes instead of starting from scratch.

title: Degradation monitoring.
description: We watch your traffic and catch problems before they turn into downtime. The visible result: incidents that never reach your users.

title: Infrastructure & software work.
description: Correction, extension, and preparation of a system according to what it objectively requires — the course the infrastructure actually needs, even where that means building less rather than more, never what deepens dependence on the provider.

title: Peak-load preparation.
description: Before a season or a launch, we stress your system, find the weak points, and harden it — so the surge doesn't take you down at your most profitable moment.

title: Abuse protection.
description: We absorb floods, bad bots, and abuse aimed at your services — with a human on it when things escalate. Honest about scale: within the bounds of your infrastructure.

title: Access management.
description: We bring order to who can reach what: roles, routes, and permissions configured so the right traffic reaches the right place — and kept current.

title: Cost audit.
description: We show you what's actually flowing through your infrastructure — including runaway automated and AI traffic — and catch cost and load anomalies before they run for months.

title: On-prem delivery of our software.
description: Want to take the L7 router and run it yourself — we hand over our software to deploy on your side, with setup help and documentation. The tool without the on-call, for those who only need the tool.
